In this role, you will be part of a close-knit and hardworking team. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that all tasks are carried out as efficiently as possible so that the workday can be completed together. 
As an All-round Supply Chain Packaging Employee, you will be responsible for packing outgoing boxes, sealing them properly, and supporting the loading team to ensure shipments are processed efficiently. In addition, you will be responsible for maintaining the ice supply for the packaging department. This means you will regularly enter the freezer to collect the required ice stock and transport it to the packaging area, ensuring that all orders are kept properly cooled during the packing process. 
This shift starts at 08:00 am till 5.00 p.m.
